oracle.invariant: The script exits 0 and prints 'ALL CHECKS PASSED'. The page stays under /new/ (landing on /new/s/session-…). At least one /api/dsh-passwords/state request is made, and every one is exactly /new/api/dsh-passwords/state answering 200. Every /gateway/api/messages request (if any) goes under /new/gateway/api/messages and none answers 404; when state says chatEnabled is not false, at least one such request is made. A Tracy seat's state says chatEnabled: false, so the fixed page normally polls none — on the broken page the failed state read left the chat on by default, which is why it also polled /gateway/api/messages at the root.
